levels.label: 2. OG — windows and wall-face study
levels.source: Resident window marks, confirmation of one window per L room, and proposed wall-face offsets supplied on 15 November 2026; unchanged Bavarian exterior model.
levels.notes: The twenty-room count and all 24 exterior window locations are resident-confirmed. Exact window centers, widths and all room dimensions remain estimates. A separate 0.20m wall-face hypothesis shifts L left, widens the stairwell to about 1.67m, and gives R about 2.76m gross bays. R still does not fit the published living rectangle with the audit’s hypothetical wall inset. Shaded bands show possible wall material within gross envelopes; room areas never overlap. Four shared-area windows are unassigned to rooms or routes. The east-hall stairwell connection remains unknown. The exterior, no-floor roof wings and both lower floors are unchanged.
